instruction.text: Drag the periods of ancient Greek history to the correct parts of the timeline.

feedback.finish: The history of the ancient Greeks can be split into three periods: Archaic, Classical and Hellenistic.

atoms.a: How long did the ancient Greek civilisation last?

atoms.b: During the ((++archaic modern)) period, the Greeks started to established more and more city-states within Greece.
Most of the Greek city-states were built close to the ((++sea desert)). This allowed for lots of trade in the ((++Mediterranean Baltic)).
While most city-states were within the borders of modern-day ((++Greece Spain)), some were also founded in what is now Italy and Turkey.

instruction.text: The classical period has begun! Help the Athenians build the Parthenon, their temple to Athena.

text: In the classical period, the Greeks started building lots of cultural sites. They built temples to honour their gods and theatres to perform plays.

atoms.b: Through trade and ((++conquest randomness)), the Greeks exchanged many ideas with peoples from around the Mediterranean and beyond.
At the height of Greek power in the Hellenistic period, the empire stretched all the way from Greece to ((++India the_Moon))!
Even after the fall of Greece, many Greek ideas lived on in places like the ((++Roman Togan)) Empire.
